environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.62 on Amazon Linux 2, deployed behind an AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no inspection). PostgreSQL 14.3 RDS instance with pg_read_server_files role granted to the application database user. The servlet is mapped at /api/reports and accessible from the corporate VPN CIDR (10.0.0.0/8). No query parameterization enforcement at the database layer. pg_hba.conf allows md5 auth from the application subnet. The RDS parameter group has log_statement=none.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP listener port 443 passthrough to target group port 8443
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14.3, db.r5.large, application user has SELECT on all tables plus pg_read_server_files
config.network: VPC with app subnet 10.1.0.0/24, DB subnet 10.2.0.0/24, corporate VPN access via Transit Gateway
